## Notes

- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
- **Write channel:** the `fleet-write` relay, read back on every write.
- **Lesson recorded:** a `Regen-provenance:` pointer certifies only what the guard's own committed-tree test (`unexplainedPathsBetween`) accepts. A PR-touched, non-generated file that `main` also changed breaks the carry even when the merge was clean.
- **Lesson recorded:** a generated record that reads the ADR-0087 registries (`spec-changes.json`, the upgrade guide) goes stale when any step-18 writer lands, even with no textual conflict. CI checks the merge with the current `main`, so re-sync and regenerate before the review of record.
- **Lesson recorded:** `dispatch-gates` does not derive a whole-tree scan with no path hint (`check:future-spec-major` is one). A PR that adds generated text runs its CI job's own step list before review.
- **Lesson recorded:** dedupe before filing reads the lane's own open cards by title, not only `search_issues`. #22356 duplicated #22346 (`hourly full run: red on main`), which the semantic search did not surface.
- **Lesson recorded:** a PR that changes the migration registry runs the full `test` task of every package that reads it, `cli` above all. On #22331, `cli`'s guidance test caught a tracker id that no gate family derives.
- **Lesson recorded:** "the touched package's tests" means its full `test` task as CI's Test Core runs it, every vitest project included. A `--project unit` narrowing missed `@objectstack/cli`'s `integration` project on #22215.
- **Receipts read through `6067864881`:**
  - `domain:devx` seat 1's #22279 (`6059883904`): `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`.
  - `domain:engine` seat 1's #22250 (`6062064959`): `sortability.zod.ts` text.
  - `domain:engine` seat 1's #15206 S1 (`6067864881`): `platform-object-names.ts` and a new step-18 entry with the generated `registry.ts`.

  No claim of this seat holds those files beyond the shared generated registry (above), so there is no objection.
